Hartlaub and Finsch Beitrag zur fauna Centralpolynesiens. Ornithologie der Viti, Samoa und Tongainseln

Plate 14

Tafel XIV.

  • Fig. 1, 2. Astur cruentus Gould (Bremen Mus.) Valid name Accipiter fasciatus (Vigors and Horsfield, 1827)
  • Fig. 3. Circus assimilis Jard. (Mus. Godeffroy.) Valid name Circus assimilis Jardine & Selby, 1828
  • Fig. 4. Collocalia spodiopygia Peale (Bremen Mus.) Valid name Aerodramus spodiopygius (Peale, 1848)
  • Fig. 5 Collocalia spodiopygia Nest (Mus. Godeffroy.) Valid name Aerodramus spodiopygius (Peale, 1848)
  • Fig. 6. Myiagra castaneiventris (Bremen Mus.) Valid name Monarcha castaneiventris Verreaux, 1858
  • Fig. 7. Columba vitiensis Quoy (Mus. Godeffroy.) Valid name Columba vitiensis Quoy & Gaimard, 1830
  • Fig. 8. Rallina poeciloptera Hartl. Valid name Nesoclopeus poecilopterus (Hartlaub, 1866)
